responsibility: Declares the double_int POD type and its inline helpers for representing a signedness-neutral integer value spanning two HOST_WIDE_INT words. This header defines the public construction, extension, arithmetic, shift, comparison, bitwise, conversion, and query interfaces used by constant folding and fixed-point code, along with canonical constants, dump/GMP conversion declarations, and wi::int_traits integration so double_int can participate in GCC’s generic integer infrastructure.
same_name_distinction: Defines the double_int type, inline operators/helpers, constants, and public declarations that users include; unlike gcc/double-int.cc, it is the interface layer and trait integration point, not the file that implements the heavy arithmetic, formatting, and GMP conversion logic.
